visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of the Japanese flag waving against a backdrop of a modern glass skyscraper. Large text overlays in Traditional Chinese pose a question about why Japanese people might not welcome Chinese immigration. (2) A low-angle, medium shot captures a large number of pedestrians' lower bodies as they cross a busy urban intersection with white zebra stripes on gray asphalt. (3) A young male host with styled hair and a black pleated shirt appears in a studio setting with a blurred newsroom background. He speaks directly to the camera, using hand gestures for emphasis. (4) The scene cuts to a digital display of news headlines from SETN, accompanied by a photo of a restaurant with a sign on the door. (5) The host returns to the screen, followed by B-roll footage showing a silhouette of a person walking behind frosted glass and another person using a smartphone to photograph a red torii gate amidst autumn leaves. (6) Multiple news clippings from UDN and other outlets are layered over the screen, detailing issues like littering, traffic, and rising housing prices. (7) A night view of a brightly lit, crowded Japanese street is shown, followed by a graphic of a construction worker and coins representing 'Chinese Immigrants' and their economic impact. (8) The host provides a final summary in the studio as three bullet points appear on the screen, concluding the segment.

A male narrator introduces the topic with a clean, broadcast-quality Mandarin voice, maintaining a steady and professional pace. (2) A subtle synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect occurs as the visual transitions from the flag to the street scene, followed by a slight digital chime as graphics appear. The music remains a consistent background bed, mixed clearly below the narration. (3) The narrator continues with high articulation clarity, discussing the increase in Chinese visitors and residents in Japan. The pitch is moderate, with natural intonations that suggest a news-commentary style. (4) As the audio progresses, additional UI-style sound effects emphasize the appearance of bullet points and headlines. The music maintains its rhythmic drive without lyrical interruption, supporting the informative flow of the voice track until the final fade-out.
